# Project Alpha Proposal

Project Alpha (PA) builds a processing chain for rover images. It runs from 2024 to 2026 and is coordinated by the Alpha Imaging Lab.

## Work Plan

The work is split into three work packages.

### WP1: Data Ingestion

WP1 collects the raw rover images from the mission archive and converts them to a common format. WP1 runs in the first six months and delivers D1, the ingestion tool.

### WP2: Data Processing

WP2 turns the ingested images into calibrated mosaics. WP2 is the largest work package with 40 person-months and is led by the Alpha Imaging Lab. WP2 delivers D2, the mosaic pipeline, in month 18.

### WP3: Visualisation

WP3 builds a web viewer for the mosaics. WP3 starts in month 12 and delivers D3, the public viewer.

## Project Management

Project management in Project Alpha is done by a steering board that meets every three months. The project manager reports progress to the funding agency twice a year. Risks are tracked in a shared risk register.
